title: Acme Logistics — Warehouse Management System replacement
purpose: Replace Acme's 15-year-old in-house WMS with Stowline (SaaS) before the November peak season. The old system can no longer scale with Acme's volume growth and blocks the company's commitment to next-day fulfilment in three new regions.

in_scope: Stowline core WMS modules (receiving, putaway, picking, packing, shipping)
Migration of three live warehouses (Rotterdam, Antwerp, Düsseldorf)
Integration with Acme's existing TMS and ERP

success_criteria: Go-live on October 1, 2026, on all three warehouses
Pick accuracy ≥ 99.5% within four weeks of go-live
No more than 4 hours total downtime during cutover weekend
Floor staff Net Promoter Score for the new system ≥ +20 at 8 weeks

health.note: Vendor is two sprints behind on integration work; sponsor is signaling impatience.

risks.description: Vendor (Stowline) is consistently behind on integration sprints; impacts cutover-window planning.
risks.mitigation: Weekly vendor sync with named blockers and named owners.

risks.description: Floor staff in Düsseldorf are skeptical of any system change after the failed 2023 rollout attempt.
risks.mitigation: Earlier hands-on training; David Okonkwo to identify Düsseldorf champion.

risks.description: Sponsor wants to compress the cutover into one weekend to avoid peak-season risk; team believes a phased cutover is safer.
risks.mitigation: Open — decision pending at next steering.
